text: I opened an account with Freeway Funding in XX/XX/XXXX '. In accordance with the Fair Credit Reporting Act, this creditor has violated my rights. Under 15 USC 1681a1 " Inaccurate credit reports directly impair the efficiency of the banking system, and unfair credit reporting methods undermine the public confidence which is essential to the continued functioning of the banking system ''. Attached are my credit reports which will clearly show inaccuracies in payments and balances as well. 15 USC 1681 604a states that any consumer reporting agency can only furnish a consumer report with my written permission. 15 USC 1681 602a4 states that I have the right to privacy.
